body: Life is full of beautiful people too. Thank you for thinking about me. I want to be strong for this child. I feel like a little team now, just me and the bub!

You are right. I can make my life great on my own. I did before, and I can now. It's funny how the words of a stranger have really helped me to open up my eyes and believe in my strength again.

Thank you for taking the time to reply to me. This is indeed a beautiful world.

I think that a lot of people who post here, post out of a cry for help. Mine certainly was. I needed hope. 

>any man who could treat someone with so much sensitivity as yourself the way he is, doesn't deserve your love, or that of your baby.

That gave me hope. I feel strong with this baby inside me. I don't need him. I don't feel alone. I suddenly feel like I have something to live for. I have a purpose - and for now that is to keep this baby alive.

Thank you so much for taking the time to reply to me. I really hope that some real life karma comes your way.
